title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleRomaji: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleNative: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
synonyms: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side (Source: Yen Press)

title: Sumikko no Sora-san
titleNative: すみっこの空さん
synonyms: すみっこの空さん Petite philosophie
synopsis: A boy returns to his family home in the country and strikes up an odd friendship with the young girl who lives next door, Sora, who believes the boy is God. However, it is Plato, the boy's pet turtle, with whom Sora develops a strong bond. Plato believes Sora to be the classical Greek philosopher Socrates and calls her his teacher. Together, they ponder the mysteries and wonders of life in the quiet but beautiful countryside. (Source: Lucia Rose)

title: Hunter x Hunter

synopsis: Gon might be a country boy, but he has high aspirations. Despite his Aunt Mito's protests, Gon decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a legendary Hunter. The Hunter hopefuls begin their journey by storm-tossed ship, where Gon meets Leorio and Kurapika, the only other applicants who aren't devastated by bouts of seasickness. Having survived the terrors of the high seas, Gon and his companions now have to prove their worth in a variety of tests in order to find the elusive Exam Hall. And once they get there, will they ever leave alive...? (Source: VIZ Media)

A Story to Keep You Alive
Nos temps contraires - Je ne te laisserai pas mourir
synopsis: In the urban civilization floating in space, "Cocoon", lived four students of the United Nations University: Arata, Tara, Caesar, and Louis. These four were a new breed of human, who had undergone the process of neoteny and adapted to the space age. The entirety of human relationships are decided by contracts, and while some humans get to live for hundreds of years, others are not quite so lucky. One day, these four meet a girl with green hair in the red light district, and thus our story begins.

title: Ohten no Mon: Gate of Secrets
titleEnglish: Ohten no Mon: Gate of Secrets
titleNative: 応天の門
synopsis: Set in the Heian era, when the Fujiwara clan schemed to seize power at the Imperial Court, a court lady's mysterious disappearance suddenly occurs in the capital. Tasked by the Emperor, who fears it may be the work of the oni, Ariwara no Narihira encounters a young man named Sugawara no Michizane. This unlikely pair - the reclusive student Michizane and the famously charming Narihira, separated by class, birth, and nearly 20 years in age - team up to unravel the bizarre cases in Kyoto! From the rising talent Yak Haibara of "Kaiyu no mori"(Walks in the Woods) and "SP"(Security Police) comes a Heian-period crime suspense manga! (Source: Emaqi)
